name: vSphere Worker Node
description: Hyper-V VM - 6 vCPU / 31 GB RAM worker node. Runs on Intel Xeon Gold 6244 host in on-premises datacenter.

specifications.storage_type: Hyper-V Virtual Disk (Virtual Disk model, local or SAN)
specifications.notes: VM has 6 vCPUs out of 8 physical cores. Effective VM TDP share = 150W × (6/8) = 112.5W. Build and manager nodes use Intel Xeon Gold 6254 (18-core, 200W) — different host hardware.

embodied_carbon.vm_share_notes: Embodied carbon allocated proportionally: physical CPU × (6 vCPU / 8 physical cores).

cpu.source: Boavizta estimate for Intel Xeon Gold 6244 (Cascade Lake 14nm, ~65,000 gCO2e) × 6/8 vCPU share
cpu.notes: Intel Xeon Gold 6244 — 8-core, manufactured at Intel 14nm fabs

storage.source: Proportional virtual disk share estimate (320GB total allocated)

infrastructure_share.source: Proportional share of motherboard, chassis, PSU, NIC, cooling

embodied_carbon.allocation_method: Proportional vCPU share of physical host (6/8 cores)

lifespan.notes: Aligned with physical host refresh cycle

pue.source: Uptime Institute 2021 average for enterprise data centers
pue.notes: Replace with actual on-premises datacenter PUE if known
